scientific_integrity: A complete analytic proof, exact symbolic identities and independent rational microscopic-path checks are included. Published prior generalities are credited. No independent review, publication-priority determination or experimental validation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the discrete-time stationary four-state ring, binary adjacent-pair labels, 0<s<=1, p,q>=0, 0<p+q<1. No assertion for continuous-time lags, noisy detectors, general networks, or finite-sample detection. Potential implicit coverage by broader hidden-Markov algebra remains a publication-priority risk.
title: A sharp four-frame time arrow for a one-defect molecular-motor ring
